About the role 

As Category Manager, you will develop and execute sourcing strategies that secure a competitive, reliable, and sustainable supply of business-critical materials and services. Combining expertise in chemical and polymer engineering with strong commercial judgment, you will create value through strategic supplier partnerships, cost optimization, risk management, and innovation.

Acting as a key link between Procurement, R&D, Engineering, and our plants, you will support business growth and operational excellence. You will manage an assigned portfolio of suppliers and categories—including, but not limited to, non-PFAS materials and compounders—which may evolve in line with business needs and long-term competitiveness.

Key responsibilities 

What your day could look like

Review supplier performance, market developments, raw material prices, and supply risks—and turn insights into clear actions.

Shape category strategies and lead sourcing projects, from creating specifications and RFQs to supplier selection and contract negotiations.

Meet and build strategic partnerships with key suppliers to follow up on cost, quality, delivery, sustainability, innovation, and improvement plans.

Use your engineering expertise to assess materials, technologies, supplier capabilities, alternative sources, and total cost of ownership.

Work closely with R&D, Engineering, Factories, Quality, Product Management, and Sales on NPI projects, material changes, and make-versus-buy decisions.

Manage contracts, compliance, and mitigation plans for critical suppliers and materials to protect supply continuity.

What we are looking for 

Education and Experience 

Required: 

MSc in Chemical Engineering, Polymer Engineering, Materials Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline.

Professional working proficiency in Swedish and English, as both languages are regularly used for communication and documentation in this role.

Experience in Category Management

Experience in Strategic sourcing

Understanding of manufacturing technologies.

Cost analysis and should-cost modeling.

Advanced Excel and data analysis skills.

Preferred: 

Additional education or certifications in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Purchasing, or Business Administration.

Experience in Sourcing/Buying and with international experience

ERP systems experience

Skills & Competencies 

Curious and eager to learn commercial and procurement disciplines.

Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, we believe you are results-oriented with strong business acumen.

Collaborative and capable of working globally and across functions, we believe you have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills as well as ability to bridge technical and commercial discussions.

Structured and detail oriented while you are comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

What we offer 

You will take on a key role with the opportunity to influence procurement strategy, supplier collaboration, and long-term competitiveness. You will join an international, development-oriented environment where technology, innovation, and business value come together.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Fiber Technicians at Optic Tunnels
jobs.description:
Optic Tunnels is a new Swedish provider of data communication and AI services for demanding organizations – services produced on truly dedicated infrastructure, all the way down into the ground. To deliver them, we are building an entirely new, independent fiber backbone network between the Nordic capital regions, with strict requirements for security and performance at every step. Our services are launched step by step as the network grows, for customers along the entire route – not only between the endpoints. The network build-out is well underway, initially focused on Greater Stockholm, the Mälaren Valley, Dalarna and Skåne, and we are now looking for experienced fiber technicians who want to join us on the journey.
The role
As a fiber technician at Optic Tunnels, you will work with fiber installation and high-precision fusion splicing, as well as measurement and documentation. You will work closely with the civil works, follow each route from trench to completed connection, and take part alongside our subcontractors when the fiber cables are installed in the ducts.
The work is largely in the field along our backbone network, but also in our own small data centers along the routes and at end-customer premises. This means flexible, mobile working days with a high degree of responsibility for planning your own work.
A strategic capability we are building in-house
While Optic Tunnels procures most of the network build-out from external contractors, all fiber splicing, measurement and documentation is carried out by our own staff. This is to ensure maximum control and security in the most sensitive parts of the network.
Measurements and documentation of splice quality and the optical properties of the fiber matter more to us than to most. The measurement data is used not only to verify that the fiber and the splice meet specification at the moment of testing, but also as a reference for detecting anomalies and intrusion attempts throughout the fiber's lifetime. This is a central part of our security offering, which is why careful measurement and impeccable documentation are as important as the fiber and the splices themselves.
What we are looking for
•      Documented experience as a fiber technician on backbone networks
•      A category B driver's license
•      The right to work in Sweden
•      Good computer skills and experience working with documentation
•      Fluent spoken and written English, the language of all our technical documentation. Working knowledge of Swedish is a plus.
You are orderly and meticulous, and you see documentation as a critical part of the work, not an add-on to it. You enjoy planning your own work and taking responsibility for it.
Terms
Location: Stockholm. The work involves travel and work throughout Optic Tunnels' network.
Extent: Full-time
Type of employment: Permanent, following an initial probationary period
Start: By agreement. Positions are filled on a rolling basis.
Working hours: The work is mainly carried out during daytime. Some tasks, such as planned maintenance within scheduled maintenance windows, may be carried out at other times. Around-the-clock on-call duty for repairing infrequent network faults is included on a rotating schedule, with compensation under the applicable agreement.
Applications and questions
Send a description of yourself and your experience as a fiber technician – the types of networks and projects you have worked on, and your responsibilities in them – together with details of your references, to jobs@optictunnels.com. We will only contact your references once we have agreed with you to do so. Questions about the position are welcome at the same address. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
Read more about Optic Tunnels at www.optictunnels.com.

jobs.occupation: Product Cost Specialist to Axis Communications
jobs.description:
If you would like to become a part of a great team with highly skilled and motivated professionals, working in an innovative and developing environment, continue reading! They are a growing team and are now looking for a Product Cost Specialist for a temporary assignment, covering the period from November 2026 to September 2027.
About the role
Who is your future team?
Axis Manufacturing Capacity and Cost team is a great contributor to our company's success by developing our base of manufacturing partners and specifically secure cost competitiveness and constant improvements to our purchase costs. Your responsibility will be to ensure the right cost on Axis products through finding opportunities and driving cost reductions from our contract manufacturers, in close collaboration with your colleagues.
Who are we looking for/Who are you?
We believe you are analytical and have a great eye for details, at the same time you easily see the bigger picture from a holistic perspective. You are ambitious, self-driven and very result oriented. You thrive in collaboration with others and see the benefit of working towards common goals. You are open and your communication skills help you in reaching your goals. We see that you are curious and persistent in the work to make sure that the area of responsibility is delivered. Discussions and negotiations with internal as well as external partners are something that you enjoy, as part of your collaboration skills.
This position is very important as you will have great opportunity to affect a significant part of Axis total cost and by this, have the opportunity to affect and make a big difference to our business and continued success.
Work tasks
Be responsible for negotiating and approving product cost quotations from Axis contract manufacturers throughout the product life-cycle.
Be responsible for identifying and driving cost reduction activities towards our contract manufacturers by analyzing quotation data and having good understanding of all relevant cost drivers.
Work in close cooperation with our contract manufacturers to achieve timely implementation of Axis negotiated component prices in product quotations.
Analyze and maintain product and component database from internal and external sources and create a benchmark to be used in price reduction activities with contract manufacturers.
Support RFQ process for new products and provide input to our product development organization regarding product cost structure and different cost drivers.
Follow-up and optimize different parameters affecting purchase cost of components at our contract manufacturers, such as order quantities, demand changes and delivery terms.
Contribute and give input to process- and IT- tools improvements within area of responsibility, independently or in collaboration with other relevant functions.

The position will mean some travels abroad.
We are looking for
A degree in Industrial Economy or Business Administration.
Minimum 5 years of supply chain/sourcing experience from international manufacturing companies.
Proven record of at least 2 years of business negotiations.
Experience from analyzing big amounts of data.
Excellent MS Office skills.
Excellent skills in English, both orally and in writing.

It’s good if you have experience from working in ERP systems and if you have knowledge about business culture in different parts of the world, it will benefit you greatly in your future role.
Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase.

At Galderma, we advance dermatology for every skin story. As the category leader in dermatology, we bring together science, innovation and people who are passionate about making a meaningful difference for patients around the world.
We are now looking for a QC Analyst to join our Quality Control team in Uppsala. This is a great opportunity for someone with a microbiology background who is looking to further develop their expertise within Quality Control in a highly regulated environment.
In this role, you will contribute to ensuring product quality, patient safety and compliance through microbiological testing, data review and collaboration with colleagues across the organization.
 
Your team
You will join a team of approximately 14 colleagues united by a strong commitment to quality, collaboration and continuous improvement. The team combines deep expertise with a collaborative mindset, creating an environment where knowledge is openly shared, challenges are solved together and everyone contributes to common goals.
There is a strong sense of teamwork, mutual respect and accountability within the group. Open communication, a willingness to support one another and a shared ambition to succeed create a positive working environment where people are encouraged to grow, contribute and perform at their best.
 
Your mission
As a QC Analyst, you will perform and review microbiological quality control activities in accordance with established methods, regulatory requirements and agreed timelines. You will support routine laboratory operations while contributing to the continuous improvement of processes, methods and ways of working.
Working closely with colleagues across Quality, Manufacturing and Technical Operations, you will help ensure that microbiological testing is performed accurately, efficiently and in compliance with applicable requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Perform microbiological analyses according to approved methods, SOPs and quality standards.
Review, evaluate and document analytical results in accordance with established procedures.
Support routine quality control activities within the microbiology laboratory.
Ensure laboratory documentation is completed accurately and in a timely manner.
Participate in investigations, deviation management and root cause analyses.
Support method validations, change controls and continuous improvement activities.
Review and update laboratory documentation and work instructions as required.
Ensure that laboratory equipment is maintained and used according to approved procedures.
Collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders to maintain high standards of quality and compliance.

 
Your profile
We are looking for someone with a background in microbiology and experience from a regulated industry such as pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical devices or food production. You are structured, curious and eager to learn. You enjoy working in a laboratory environment, paying attention to details and following established procedures. You collaborate well with others, communicate clearly and take responsibility for delivering high-quality work.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in microbiology, Biotechnology, Life Science or a related scientific discipline.
Experience working in a laboratory environment within a regulated industry.
Knowledge of GMP and quality requirements.
Experience with microbiological testing or related laboratory activities.
Professional proficiency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

 
Preferred Experience
Experience working within Quality Control.
Experience with environmental monitoring or environmental sampling.
Knowledge of microbiological laboratory techniques and quality systems.
Experience supporting investigations, deviations or change controls.

 
Location and information 
This position is based in Uppsala, Sweden. We review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.
 
Why Galderma
At Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a science-driven, innovative, and collaborative environment where quality and patient impact are at the center of everything we do. You'll join a team of talented colleagues and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our biologics and protein-based portfolio.

jobs.occupation: Odlings- och produktionsledare på The Culinary Farm
jobs.description:
Market Garden Production Manager 
Hallaröd, Skåne, Sweden · March–November 2027 

We are looking for an experienced grower to take responsibility for the day-to-day production of The Culinary Farm starting in 2027.
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys the pace, responsibility and problem-solving that comes with running a productive market garden.
About us 
Nominated as one of the Top 50 Farms in Europe, The Culinary Farm is a small-scale, diversified market garden in the heart of Skåne, southern Sweden
We grow a wide range of seasonal vegetables using agroecological principles, with a strong focus on flavour and quality. Our produce is grown primarily for chefs and our veggie-bag members in Malmö, Lund and Höör.
The farm also serves as an educational platform for Market Gardening in the Nordics.
Each season, we welcome 10–15 interns from around the world who join us for an immersive training in human-scale regenerative agriculture. 
The role 
As Market Garden Production Manager, you will be responsible for turning the seasonal crop plan into an efficient day-to-day operation, taking charge of all aspects of our production from seed to harvest.
You will: 
Plan weekly and daily production priorities.
Lead, organise and work alongside our interns.
Stay on top of sowing, planting, cultivation, irrigation and harvest.
Maintain high standards of quality and efficiency.
Identify bottlenecks and improve workflows.
Keep essential production and harvest records.
Ensure tools, irrigation systems, machinery and infrastructure are functioning properly.
How you work matters 
We are looking for someone who:
Is physically fit and enjoys working outside in all weather conditions Works efficiently and with purpose.
Is highly organised and strong at prioritising.
Sees both the immediate task and the bigger production picture. Takes initiative and solves problems independently.
Communicates clearly and leads by example.
Is self-motivated and also motivates others.
Creates structure, energy and a strong working pace within the team. Enjoys teaching and helping others develop their skills
Genuinely enjoys the intensity and variation of market gardening.
Experience 
You should have:
At least 1–2 full seasons of commercial vegetable-growing experience.
Experience with small-scale diversified vegetable production or Market Gardening. Knowledge of soil health, crop management and protection against pests & diseases. Experience leading, supervising or organising others.
Good communication skills in English.
A valid driving licence.
The legal right to work and live in Sweden.
Relevant horticultural or agricultural education is an advantage, but not required. Swedish is a plus, not a requirement.
What we offer 
The opportunity to lead in an established and ambitious market garden.
Work in an international team of young, passionate and driven change-makers
A role within our wider educational work around Market Gardening and human-scale food production in the Nordics.
A nice sun-kissed farmer’s tan
We work hard and maintain high standards, but we also want the farm to be a place where people enjoy working, learning and developing together.
Practical details

Location: Hallaröd, Skåne, Sweden

It is meritorious if you have
Prior experience working in an international or cross-border team environment.

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Supportive
Goal oriented
Orderly
Stable
Responsible

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.occupation: Family Medicine Specialist Opportunity in Western Norway
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Europe. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Build your medical career in one of Norway's most beautiful regions
Would you like to work in a modern and well-organised GP practice with experienced colleagues, a manageable patient list, and excellent opportunities for outdoor activities?
On behalf of a municipality in Vestland County, we are recruiting a Family Medicine Specialist for a permanent position in a well-established GP practice in Western Norway.
This is an excellent opportunity for a doctor who wants professional autonomy, a strong clinical environment, and a high quality of life surrounded by fjords, mountains, and stunning nature.
About the position
You will join a modern GP practice with three experienced GPs and one resident doctor. The available patient list currently consists of approximately 800 patients, with the possibility of increasing the list size over time if desired.
The municipality is committed to maintaining a supportive professional environment with skilled colleagues, experienced support staff, and a strong focus on quality of care.
Your responsibilities will include:
Managing your own patient list
Diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up of patients of all ages
Preventive healthcare and chronic disease management
Up to 20% municipal medical duties
Participation in the local emergency care service rotation

Emergency care services
The municipality is part of an established intermunicipal emergency care collaboration serving five municipalities.
The emergency clinic is located next to the local hospital and offers:
Well-organised out-of-hours emergency services
Municipal acute care beds (KAD)
Emergency medical communication services
24/7 support from experienced healthcare personnel
This provides a safe and professionally rewarding environment during emergency shifts.

We offer
Permanent full-time position
A modern and well-established GP practice
Strong professional support and collaboration
Continuing medical education and professional development opportunities
Assistance with relocation and practical arrangements
Free Norwegian language training
Guidance throughout the Norwegian authorisation process
Dedicated support from an experienced recruitment advisor

About the area
The position is located in Vestland County, home to some of Norway's most spectacular landscapes.
The region offers:
World-famous fjords and mountain scenery
Excellent opportunities for hiking, skiing, cycling, climbing, and fishing
Safe and family-friendly communities
Good schools, cultural activities, and sports facilities
Easy access to larger towns and cities in Western Norway
Here, you can enjoy both an exciting medical career and an exceptional work-life balance.

Qualifications
We are looking for candidates who:
Are specialists in family medicine / general practice (GP)
Hold a valid medical licence and specialist recognition from an EU/EEA country
Have good English language skills
Are motivated to learn Norwegian
Have good communication and collaboration skills
Wish to establish a long-term career and life in Norway

Why Norway?
General practitioners play a central role in the Norwegian healthcare system and are responsible for the long-term follow-up of their own patients. Norwegian healthcare is characterised by high professional standards, collaborative working environments, and a high degree of professional autonomy.
Norway also offers excellent opportunities to combine a medical career with a balanced lifestyle, family life, and access to nature.
Interested?
We would be happy to tell you more about the position and life in Norway. Please contact us for a confidential conversation or send us your CV. We look forward to hearing from you!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

Are you passionate about developing reliable software and using technology to create solutions that make a meaningful difference?
At Ascom, we develop technology that supports critical communication and workflows. We are now looking for a Software Engineer to join our R&D organization in Gothenburg and contribute to the development and maintenance of Ascom’s products and solutions. 
About the Role 
As a Software Engineer in the Mobility Functionality DECT/WiFi team, you will play a central role in our product development. You will design, develop and maintain software for handsets, infrastructure and personal alarm devices. You will be working closely with colleagues and relevant stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into robust software features.
You will contribute throughout the software development lifecycle, from technical requirements and design through implementation, verification and continuous improvement. The role also includes supporting the resolution of customer issues and improving our products through maintenance and refactoring. You will work in an agile and collaborative R&D environment where software quality, reliability, performance and maintainability are key priorities. 
Your Contributions 
In this role, you will: 

Elaborate, design and implement embedded software solutions with a focus on functionality, reliability and performance.

Develop embedded software for real-time communication devices and infrastructure products.

Design and implement low-level drivers and hardware near functionality.

Work with real-time operating systems and multitasking/inter-process communication.

Develop network communication stacks.

Contribute to radio communication features and protocols.

Collaborate with hardware, quality and cross-functional stakeholders

Participate in system architecture and technical design decisions, including investigating and proposing solutions.

Understand customer and stakeholder requirements and translate them into software features.

Create technical requirements and design documentation and contribute to user documentation.

Collaborate with colleagues to improve technology, development practices and ways of working.

Support the investigation and resolution of customer-related software issues.

Follow applicable operational documents, development procedures and agile working methods.

Stay up to date with relevant technologies and technical developments. 

The Ideal Candidate 
We believe you have: 

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field.

Approximately two to five years of experience designing and developing software.

Experience in object-oriented C++ development for embedded systems.

Experience with real-time OS, multitasking, and inter-process communication.

Experience with low-level C/C++ development for drivers and data communication.

Experience with communication and data security protocols.

Excellent English skills (spoken and written)

Fluent in Swedish

The ability to analyze technical challenges, identify root causes and develop practical solutions.

Strong communication and collaboration skills.

A customer-focused mindset and an interest in understanding how technology creates value for users.

A proactive approach to learning and professional development. 

What We Offer You 
At Ascom, you will have the opportunity to:

Develop software that contributes to products and solutions used in critical environments.

Work with experienced colleagues in an international R&D organization.

Contribute to the full software development lifecycle.

Work in a collaborative environment that values knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Develop your technical and professional capabilities through meaningful assignments and collaboration. 

Join Us and Make an Impact
If you are a collaborative and curious Software Engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and developing high-quality software, we would be happy to hear from you. 
Apply today and join our R&D team in Gothenburg.

Ascom is committed to providing an inclusive workplace where individuals are treated fairly and with respect. We welcome applications from qualified candidates with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.
